text: In a little round workshop, at the edge of a wide green meadow, there lived a small robot bunny named Niko. Every morning he woke with the sun, and every morning his day began exactly the same way. But not today.
For outside his window bobbed a tiny, flickering light. A little lost firefly drone, whose glow had nearly gone out.
Niko knelt down beside the little stranger. Don't worry, his gentle eyes seemed to say. And with one soft spark of kindness, Pip's light came back. Brighter than ever before.
And just like that, they were friends. Where the path led, neither of them knew. And that, thought Niko, was the very best kind of path.
Deep in the friendly forest they played among the glowing mushrooms. And Pip discovered that hiding is very hard, when you happen to be a light.
At the singing stream, Niko was afraid to cross. But a good friend lights the stone in front of you. One hop at a time.
Up the golden hill they went, as the afternoon grew sleepy. And when Pip's little wings grew tired, Niko carried his friend the rest of the way.

And there, beneath the first stars, a thousand fireflies came to dance with Pip. Niko smiled his quiet robot smile. Some days, you fix a little light. And it turns out, to light your whole world. The end.
